I recently popped in for a treat for myself, and wanted to try something relatively new. My skin is very dull and congested at the moment and the assistant recommended either this mask or cupcake. I have to say I have tried cupcake previously and I found the smell cloying so I wanted to avoid. This mask is really blue, but given some of the brown masks look like poop, or the green ones look like some sort of evil smoothie I can deal with bright blue. Tonight is my third application of DLAM, and I have to say this is NOT a mask for the night before a big event! The citrus content really brightens but if you have any underlying congestion at all in your skin you **will** break out. That being said, for treatment of blackheads and congestion over a longer period of time I think this mask will be really effective. I really liked the rice bran in there as a scrub, and it's great to see a natural alternative to microbeads. It is quite drying so make sure you moisturise. I would recommend something soothing like Imperialis because you can be a little pink afterwards. I really do rate the Lush fresh face masks for value - this cost £6.95 and there are at least another 4 or 5 applications in the pot. I think the price, number of applications, effectiveness and quality of ingredients really does stack up for it, plus the fact that it is certainly a more ethical purchase than some of the major cosmetics brands. **Get this product if:** *You have dull skin *You like a physical and chemical exfoliator *You want to use it as part of a longer term treatment **Don't get this product if:** *You have a big event the next day *You have skin sensitivity *You don't like fruit acids *You have very dry skin
REVIEW - Don't Look At Me Fresh Face Mask
